def:ncg-grand-tensor.title: Finite Renewal Grand Tensor
def:ncg-grand-tensor.note: Partial: the components are encoded separately (future-minimal carrier Z^min as the quotient by complete finite-future laws; normalized regular trace tau_reg = Tr(L_a)/dim A; categorical predictive quotient Qpred); missing: a bundled Grand Tensor object with the represented history algebra A^hist and the word-Gram hierarchy K_{X,r}.

prop:ncg-grand-tensor-reconstruction.title: Canonical finite Grand-Tensor reconstruction
prop:ncg-grand-tensor-reconstruction.note: Partial: clause (i) is proved (right congruence of future equivalence, and the unique surjection from any reachable deterministic realization onto Z^min intertwining branch and occurring updates); clause (iii) regular-trace invariance under *-isomorphism is proved; tomographic uniqueness of a linear map from spanning preparations/separating effects is proved. Missing: (ii) uniqueness of the support-minimal represented history algebra up to represented *-isomorphism and invariance of the word-Gram hierarchy, hence (iv).

thm:summary-finite.title: Spectralization, Dirac ambiguity, and calibrated image
thm:summary-finite.note: Aggregate of thm:finite-spectralization, prop:no-scale, thm:commutant-fibre and thm:essential-image; see those records for the scoped renderings (coordinate packet whose Leibniz/right-linearity/reversal-intertwining fields are hypotheses, abstract linear-constraint commutant model, and image equalities rendered as existence certificates plus the exact strict criterion and Toeplitz properness witness).

thm:summary-metric.title: Independent metric reconstruction and stable compact-spin convergence
thm:summary-metric.note: Partial: clause (i) is proved (graph Hodge-Dirac square/commutator identities and uniform convergence of the A3 Connes distance to the flat torus quotient metric); for (iv) only the abstract collectively-compact strong-plus-adjoint to norm-resolvent upgrade is proved. Missing: (ii) relation-adapted cellular completion and its compact limit, (iii) covariant Wilson species/graph estimates, the atlas-based norm-resolvent theorem, and (v) the global metric head.

thm:summary-universality.title: Universality fibres and coarse graining
thm:summary-universality.note: Partial: (i) the current fibre (open conductance box in ker B, dimension b_1, entropy zero iff j=0) is proved but not the modular-class recovery of the generator; (ii) only Hankel-rank minimal realization and unique similarity (no Stieltjes measure classification, no Pontryagin index); (iii) only the Z/2 special case (holonomy separates H^1(Gamma;Z/2)); (iv) only b_1 monotonicity and a lumpable entropy split; (v) nothing.

def:finite-real-differential.title: Finite real differential datum
def:finite-real-differential.note: Packet bundles the Hilbert bimodule K (commuting star-adjoint left/right actions), the conjugate-linear involution reversing the actions, and delta; IsStarBimoduleDerivation is exactly delta(1)=0, Leibniz, and C delta(a)=delta(a^*). The universal calculus ker(m), d_u, the bimodule map T_delta and the source-minimal quotient-to-range carrier are encoded as well. Scoped: A is a normed complex star-algebra with a finite basis.

thm:finite-spectralization.title: Finite spectralization
thm:finite-spectralization.note: Proved in orthonormal coordinates: D Hermitian and odd, J antiunitary with J^2=1, JD=DJ, J gamma=gamma J, opposite representation R_b (+) rho(b), order-zero and first-order identities, the commutator block formula and the exact norm identity ||[D,pi(a)]||=||B_a|| for a=a^*. Scoped: the Lean Packet takes as structural hypotheses the properties the paper derives from Definition finite-real-differential (Leibniz block identity, right-linearity of B_a, reversal intertwining J_1 d = d J_0), and faithfulness of pi is not stated.

prop:no-scale.title: No algebra-and-trace determination of the Dirac scale
prop:no-scale.note: D -> sD and L_D -> sL_D are proved literally for s>0 on the coordinate packet (scaling the differential block, which is the canonical identification of the one-form carriers); the distance law d -> s^{-1} d is proved for the attained finite Connes variational maximum between two linear functionals.

prop:finite-CQMS.title: Compact quantum metric-space structure
prop:finite-CQMS.note: Partial: for the commutative graph algebras C(V) with connected conductance support, the finite Connes distance between vertices (pure states) is proved to be a genuine metric; missing: the general finite algebra with Ker(d)=C1, the Lip-norm/weak-* statement on the full state space, the Leibniz and star identities, and the converse for a larger kernel.

prop:austere-zero-mode.title: Unit zero-mode of the austere Hodge construction
prop:austere-zero-mode.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: unitVector, zero mode, dirac one, delta 1 = 0. The unit clause delta(1)=0 appears only as a conjunct of FiniteDifferentialOccurrenceCompiler.Packet.IsStarBimoduleDerivation; D(1,0)=0 and non-invertibility of the Hodge operator are not stated. The commutant clause is thm:commutant-fibre.

thm:commutant-fibre.title: Exact Dirac commutant fibre
thm:commutant-fibre.note: Proved in an abstract finite-dimensional real inner-product model: the derivation X -> [X,pi(.)] and the grading/reality sign equations are arbitrary R-linear constraint maps, the compatible anchor space is their common kernel, the solution set is the affine fibre D + c, the centered point D - P_c D is the unique minimum-norm representative, and q = dim c real coordinates are necessary and sufficient. Scoped: the identification of the abstract kernel with the concrete self-adjoint commutant c_S is the instantiation, not a separate lemma.

thm:essential-image.title: Calibrated marked image and norm-compatible essential image
thm:essential-image.note: The three lines are rendered as: (1) every coordinate finite (real even) spectral packet has a marked realization retaining the calibrated unitary germ i U'(0)=D and the source-minimal commutator Gram; (2) every SpectralTriple with compact resolvent (no separability hypothesis needed) has finite Dirac spectral screens with strong convergence of compressions, matrix coefficients and product defects; (3) norm multiplicativity of the compressions is equivalent to two-sided quasidiagonal corner decay for any family of self-adjoint idempotents along a filter; properness is the Toeplitz number-operator/shift certificate. Scoped: the equalities EssIm = Spec are stated through these certificates rather than as category-theoretic essential images.

def:supp-renewal-graph.title: Stationary finite renewal graph
def:supp-renewal-graph.note: The weighted incidence differential, block Hodge-Dirac matrix, graded representation, symmetrized conductance c=(q+q^T)/2 and connectedness of the positive-conductance support are encoded in orthonormal coordinates; stationarity and positivity of masses/rates enter as the hypotheses of canonical_graph_spectralization. Scoped: real scalars, both orientations retained via V x V.

thm:supp-graph-square.title: Renewal Hodge square and exact Lipschitz seminorm
thm:supp-graph-square.note: From positive masses, nonnegative stationary rates and connected conductance support: d^*d f = -(L f + L^dagger f) = -2 L_s f in vertex coordinates, ||[D,f]||^2 = max_x (1/m_x) sum_y c_xy |f(y)-f(x)|^2 for real f, the kernel is exactly the constants, and the resulting Connes distance on V is a metric. Scoped: real-valued vertex functions.

cth:supp-extensive-kernel.title: Extensive kernel of the one-step graph calculus
cth:supp-extensive-kernel.note: dim ker D = 2e+2-n for the block Dirac of any differential d:V->W with dim V=n, dim W=2e and dim ker d=1 (the connectedness input is taken as this hypothesis), the A3 count 11n+2, and unboundedness of these nullities (the no-compact-resolvent-limit clause is rendered as this unboundedness).

lem:supp-A3-frame.title: $A_3$ tight-frame identity
lem:supp-A3-frame.note: sum_alpha alpha alpha^T = 8 I and (1/8) sum_alpha <v,alpha>^2 = |v|^2 are proved for the explicit twelve roots (+-e_i +- e_j) of A3 written in R^3 coordinates of W_0 rather than in the R^4 hyperplane presentation.

thm:supp-A3-finite.title: Exact finite $A_3$ spectralization
thm:supp-A3-finite.note: Partial: the exact seminorm formula L_h(f)^2 = max_x (1/(8h^2)) sum_alpha |f(x+h alpha)-f(x)|^2 on the periodic A3 graph (masses h^3, conductances h/8) and D_h^2 = -2 L_h (via the general stationary theorem) are proved, and L_h(F|V_h) -> ||grad F||_inf uniformly for lattice-periodic C^1 F with continuous derivative is proved; missing: the explicit O(h ||F||_{C^2}) rate and the generator convergence L_h F -> (1/2) Delta F.

lem:supp-A3-compactness.title: Compactness of discrete unit-Lipschitz functions
lem:supp-A3-compactness.note: Partial: anchored discrete unit-ball functions admit 18-Lipschitz Euclidean extensions with a uniformly convergent subsequence on every closed ball; missing: the sharp limit bound |grad F| <= 1 a.e. and the W^{1,inf} identification (the Lean distance proof avoids this lemma by smoothing).

thm:supp-A3-distance.title: Renewal--spectral distance identity
thm:supp-A3-distance.note: sup over vertex pairs of |d_h(x,y) - d_g(x,y)| -> 0 is proved with d_h the actual finite commutator-supremum Connes distance and d_g the flat quotient metric of W_0/Lambda_{A3}. Scoped: d_g is taken as the flat lattice quotient metric directly; the paper's identification of that metric with the second-moment reconstruction is not part of the Lean statement.

lem:positive-stencil-main.title: Positive local stencil
lem:positive-stencil-main.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: stencil, e_i + e_j, positive decomposition, inverse metric, good cover. NCG/Lorentz/IntegerStencil.lean (stencil_moment_psd, stencil_moment_trace) proves only the converse consistency (weighted rank-one sums are psd), not the existence of positive weights.

thm:compact-spin-main.title: Norm-resolvent convergence criterion under atlas stability
thm:compact-spin-main.note: Partial: the abstract analytic step of the proof (strong convergence of a collectively compact family and of its adjoints implies operator-norm convergence, with compact limit) is proved; missing: the Wilson operators, the atlas hypotheses, Rellich compactness of embedded resolvents, identification of the limit with (D-z)^{-1}, and the metric-head convergence.

def:supp-current-polytope.title: Admissible cycle-current polytope
def:supp-current-polytope.note: J(G,c) = {j : B j = 0, |j_e| < c_e} is encoded for a complex incidence matrix and real currents; the closed (non-strict) variant is not encoded.

thm:supp-graph-realization.title: Stationary Markov realization fibre of a metric graph triple
thm:supp-graph-realization.note: Partial: k = (c +- j)/m formulas, positivity of both directed rates iff |j_e| < c_e, the unique symmetric/antisymmetric flux decomposition (converse direction), membership of j=0, and dependence of the spectralization on (m,c) alone are proved; missing: the equivalence between B j = 0 (abstract incidence matrix) and the mass-stationarity equation of def:supp-renewal-graph for q = c + j, i.e. that each fibre point is a stationary renewal generator in the sense of the definition.

cor:supp-fibre-dimension.title: Dimension and faithfulness of the fibre
cor:supp-fibre-dimension.note: Partial: dim ker B = |E|-|V|+1 for connected incidence and triviality exactly at the tree cardinality are proved (over C for the ambient cycle kernel); missing: the nonfaithfulness sentence, which needs a nonzero current inside the open box when b_1 > 0 (not compiled).

prop:supp-entropy.title: Entropy production inside one spectral fibre
prop:supp-entropy.note: sigma(j) = 2 sum_e j_e log((c_e+j_e)/(c_e-j_e)) is taken as the definition; nonnegativity and vanishing exactly at j=0 are proved under 0 < c_e and |j_e| < c_e. Scoped: the derivation of this formula from (1/2) sum (q_xy - q_yx) log(q_xy/q_yx) is not compiled.

thm:supp-spectral-universality.title: Finite spectral universality
thm:supp-spectral-universality.note: Partial: every nonzero admissible current has entropy production different from the reversible member while sharing the same (m,c), and the cycle-kernel dimension is b_1; missing: existence of a nonzero admissible current for b_1 > 0 (hence of the open family) and any formal notion of non-isomorphic predictive dynamics beyond the entropy witness.

lem:supp-zero-affinity.title: Zero affinity class forces reversibility
lem:supp-zero-affinity.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: arctanh, artanh, tanh, affinity class, coboundary, divergence free. Only unrelated uses of tanh/artanh exist.

thm:supp-nonlinear-Hodge.title: Nonlinear Hodge theorem for stationary affinities
thm:supp-nonlinear-Hodge.note: Partial: the linear Hodge calculus of the incidence matrix (Moore-Penrose cut/cycle projectors, exactness of an edge cochain iff its cycle periods vanish, orthogonal energy minimization) is proved; missing: the arctanh affinity map, the convex log-cosh functional, its unique minimizer and the diffeomorphism J(G,c) -> H^1(G;R).

cor:supp-faithful-modular.title: Faithful metric--modular enrichment
cor:supp-faithful-modular.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: modular enrichment, affinity class, faithful, tanh. Depends on thm:supp-nonlinear-Hodge, which has no Lean counterpart.

thm:supp-Tomita.title: Finite modular-reversal identities
thm:supp-Tomita.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Tomita, modular conjugation, edge reversal, Delta_q, S_q, opposite action. NCG/Upstream/KMSDual.lean and ModularSpectral.lean treat the KMS/Petz dual on matrix algebras, not the edge-reversal packet.

thm:supp-modular-Hodge.title: Cellular modular Hodge reconstruction
thm:supp-modular-Hodge.note: Partial: for a finite real Hilbert complex d_0, d_1 with d_1 d_0 = 0 every one-cochain decomposes orthogonally as d_0 phi + h + d_1^* psi with d_1 h = 0; missing: the Moore-Penrose reconstruction of the coexact part from F_a = d_1 a, injectivity/surjectivity of [a] -> (h_a, F_a), the canonical representative, the norm identity and the Bianchi identity d_2 F_a = 0.

cor:supp-modular-trichotomy.title: Flat, globally twisted, and curved modular branches
cor:supp-modular-trichotomy.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: trichotomy, face curvature, global holonomy, three-torus, flat sector dimension three.

thm:supp-face-holonomy.title: Face holonomy
thm:supp-face-holonomy.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: face holonomy, two-cell, coboundary formula, exp(2F). The 'face holonomy' in NCG/Grand/RelationalDeSitterBranch.lean is a de Sitter curvature-cell remainder, not this identity.

def:supp-POVM.title: Positive operator-valued tail measure
def:supp-POVM.note: Partial: only finite-outcome POVMs (positive effects summing to one) and the matrix Stieltjes transform B^*(A-z)^{-1}B of a finite Hermitian pair are encoded; missing: a weakly countably additive B(H)-valued Borel measure on (0,infinity) and its Stieltjes self-energy integral.

con:supp-Naimark-tail.title: Canonical minimal Stieltjes dilation
con:supp-Naimark-tail.note: Partial: the finite-outcome Naimark dilation (stacked square-root isometry and coordinate projections) is constructed; missing: the simple-function Hilbert space K_mu, the projection-valued measure P_mu, C_mu = int lambda dP_mu and B_mu = V_mu^* for a Borel operator measure.

thm:supp-Naimark-realization.title: Operator-measure realization and minimality
thm:supp-Naimark-realization.note: Partial: for a finite-outcome POVM the dilation is isometric, the outcomes are orthogonal projections resolving one, and compression recovers every effect; missing: the resolvent identity Sigma_mu(z) = B(C-z)^{-1}B^*, the minimality span, the converse from (C,B) and the unique intertwining unitary between minimal realizations.

thm:supp-dynamic-jets.title: Static shadows, inverse moments, and positive Euclidean memory
thm:supp-dynamic-jets.note: Partial: the Herglotz sign is proved in the finite atomic case (Im of the matrix Stieltjes transform is a Poisson-kernel weighted sum of psd spectral weights), and the zero-mass response int lambda^{-1} dSigma and Euclidean memory int e^{-t lambda} dSigma are defined for scalar measures with scaling laws; missing: general operator measures, the inverse-moment boundary jets, and the Laplace relation Sigma(-s) = int e^{-st} K(t) dt.

thm:supp-memory-determinacy.title: Determinacy on controlled support
thm:supp-memory-determinacy.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: determinacy, moment sequence, compact support, Stone-Weierstrass, exponential moment, Laplace transform uniqueness.

cth:supp-moment-indeterminate.title: All integer moments can miss the dynamic self-energy
cth:supp-moment-indeterminate.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: lognormal, sin(2 pi log x), indeterminate, Stieltjes transform injectivity. The nearest witness, NCG.ResistanceClock.mass_moment_not_determine_response in NCG/Grand/EasyExact03.lean, shows only that mass and first moment fail to determine the zero response for a two-card family.

thm:supp-contact-escape.title: High-energy memory escape and instantaneous contact terms
thm:supp-contact-escape.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: escape, one-point compactification, weak-* compactness, contact term, delta_0, tail measure. NCG/Grand/EscapeHeadConcentrationExact.lean concerns finite operator escape estimates of a different theorem.

cth:supp-contact-static.title: The static triple does not identify escaped memory
cth:supp-contact-static.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: approximate identity, lambda e^{-lambda t}, contact static, delta_0.

def:supp-marked-spectral-packet.title: Marked spectral packet
def:supp-marked-spectral-packet.note: Partial: the unmarked finite real even packet (A, H, D, J, gamma) is encoded in coordinates; missing: the auxiliary marking data m and the compact automorphism group G_S = Aut(S) preserving the marks.

thm:supp-marked-bundle.title: Marked spectral-bundle descent
thm:supp-marked-bundle.note: Partial: the abelian special case G_S = Z/2 is proved (walk lifting/monodromy of the signed double cover, principal deck action, trivialization exactly for coboundaries, and holonomy separating H^1(Gamma;Z/2)); missing: general compact G_S, conjugation by frame changes, and the classification Hom(pi_1, G_S)/G_S.

cor:supp-twisted-bundle.title: Nontrivial monodromy is a twisted geometry
cor:supp-twisted-bundle.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: twisted spectral geometry, nontrivial monodromy, marked isomorphism. Only the Z/2 signed-cover case of thm:supp-marked-bundle exists.

thm:supp-character-shadow.title: Line characters are incomplete shadows of frame holonomy
thm:supp-character-shadow.note: Partial: for the determinant-sign character of real record transports, the character holonomy of a walk equals the sign of det of the composed frame transport (so trivial frame holonomy forces trivial determinant-line holonomy); missing: arbitrary U(1)/Pfaffian characters and the kernel-intersection criterion for the converse.

cth:supp-det-no-frame.title: A trivial determinant line need not trivialize the packet
cth:supp-det-no-frame.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: SU(2) monodromy, determinant line, diag(e^{i theta}, e^{-i theta}), multiplicity two.

thm:supp-current-chain.title: Current-chain functor
thm:supp-current-chain.note: Partial: b_1 cannot increase under a surjective map of Z/2 cycle spaces, and for a generator Markov retract with strictly positive rates the fine entropy production equals the coarse one plus two nonnegative hidden terms (entropy contraction in lumpable form); missing: the chain identity d_bar Q_E = Q_V d, the map of current polytopes, the exact sequence and the kernel dimension b_1(G)-b_1(G_bar).

thm:supp-memory-RG.title: Exact memory RG semigroup
thm:supp-memory-RG.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: RG_Lambda, memory cutoff, inverse moment head correction, screen error, semigroup law. NCG/Grand/QuasilocalContactRenormalization.lean concerns counterterm-bank renormalization, not this cutoff semigroup.

thm:supp-monodromy-descent.title: Exact marked-monodromy descent
thm:supp-monodromy-descent.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: monodromy descent, quotient of fundamental group, kernel condition, graph contraction, character descent.

thm:supp-fibre-RG.title: Functorial principal universality packet
thm:supp-fibre-RG.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: universality packet, coarse-graining functor, Pontryagin index monotonicity, dilation rank. Only the component partials of thm:supp-current-chain exist.

lem:supp-positive-decomposition.title: Positive $d^2$-direction decomposition
lem:supp-positive-decomposition.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: stencil window, w_ij, e_i +- e_j decomposition, Sym_d. NCG/Lorentz/IntegerStencil.lean proves only the converse psd/trace consistency of weighted rank-one sums.

thm:supp-general-renewal-process.title: Reversible coframe Renewal process
thm:supp-general-renewal-process.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: coframe renewal process, predictable bracket, Laplace-Beltrami, Dirichlet form convergence, reversible packet on h Z^d.

cth:supp-metric-no-coframe.title: The metric bracket does not select the spin marking
cth:supp-metric-no-coframe.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: coframe, spin structure, spin lift, SO(d) rotation, Z_2 spin holonomy.

lem:supp-density-symmetric.title: Exact density-symmetric Dirac identity
lem:supp-density-symmetric.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: density symmetric, rho^{1/2}, sqrt det g, spin connection, Clifford contraction.

thm:supp-general-Wilson-ellipticity.title: Frozen symbol, unique species, and uniform graph estimate
thm:supp-general-Wilson-ellipticity.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: Wilson term, Brillouin, doubler, species, frozen symbol, Garding. The Wilson files in NCG/Gravity and NCG/Grand concern Wilson loops/Wilsonian flows; NCG/Lorentz/AliasingObstruction.lean records only the centered-difference aliasing zero that the Wilson term is designed to remove.

lem:supp-general-core.title: Smooth-core consistency and the Wilson term
lem:supp-general-core.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: smooth core consistency, cell average, piecewise constant reconstruction, Wilson core smallness, H^3.

def:stable-spin-atlas.title: Compatible stable spin discretization
def:stable-spin-atlas.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: stable spin discretization, atlas, reconstruction estimate, global graph estimate, sampled spinor core.

thm:supp-compact-spin-resolvent.title: Norm-resolvent convergence for compatible stable atlases
thm:supp-compact-spin-resolvent.note: Partial: the compactness upgrade used in the proof (a collectively compact sequence converging strongly together with its adjoints converges in operator norm, with compact limit) is proved for a fixed Hilbert space; missing: the atlas hypotheses (A1)-(A3), Rellich compactness of the embedded resolvents, identification of the limit as (D-z)^{-1} via the smooth core, the periodic-extension statement and the spectral-projection consequences.

thm:supp-global-metric.title: Exact finite metric head and geodesic convergence
thm:supp-global-metric.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: shortest path, graph distance, geodesic, endpoint block, mesoscopic scale, Kantorovich. The finite Connes distance metric laws in NCG/Grand/FiniteConnesDistanceMetricExact.lean do not identify the distance with a shortest-path metric.

cor:supp-compact-spin-image.title: Conditional stable compact-spin approximation
cor:supp-compact-spin-image.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: compact spin approximation, essential surjectivity, spin manifold. Depends on thm:supp-compact-spin-resolvent and thm:supp-global-metric, neither compiled.

def:supp-rational-Hermitian.title: Normalized rational Hermitian dynamic function
def:supp-rational-Hermitian.note: Partial: the Hankel column space spanned by shifted columns of an N-indexed matrix kernel, the shift A_Q and the source Gamma_Q are encoded; missing: the rational Hermitian function Q with Q(z-bar)^* = Q(z), its Laurent coefficients, and the indefinite Hankel form [c_i(u), c_j(v)] = <u, M_{i+j} v> with its null-space quotient.

thm:supp-complete-rational-Krein.title: Complete normalized rational generalized-Nevanlinna realization
thm:supp-complete-rational-Krein.note: Partial: the canonical Hankel realization reproduces every coefficient M_n = output A^n source, is reachable and observable with dimension equal to the stabilized Hankel rank, every realization has at least that dimension, and two minimal realizations are uniquely similar; missing: the resolvent formula Q(z) = Gamma^+ (A-z)^{-1} Gamma, the Pontryagin form and negative index, the Nevanlinna-kernel negative-square count, and unitarity of the intertwiner for the indefinite form.

thm:supp-pole-Hankel.title: Pole--Hankel invariants
thm:supp-pole-Hankel.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: principal part, McMillan degree, Jordan block, local Pontryagin inertia, conjugate pole pair, Sylvester inertia.

cor:supp-all-rational.title: All finite rational Hermitian dynamics
cor:supp-all-rational.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: descriptor realization, infinity chain, polynomial jet, regular pencil, Pontryagin descriptor.

thm:supp-common-source.title: Joint Gram classification
thm:supp-common-source.note: Partial: for the commutator Gram G = S^*S the minimal factorization dimension equals rank G and is attained by the positive square root, and a source-fixing intertwiner between realizations is unique under Krylov surjectivity; missing: the correlation spectrahedron Corr_X with identity diagonal blocks, classification of joint realizations by Corr_X / G_X, and the residual stabilizer statement.

cth:supp-pairwise-not-global.title: Pairwise positivity need not give a joint realization
cth:supp-pairwise-not-global.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: 3/4 correlation matrix, eigenvalue -1/2, pairwise positive principal blocks, joint Gram. NCG/Grand/PairwiseNoHypergraph.lean is a different three-bit marginal counterexample.

thm:supp-finite-exhaustion.title: Finite stratified inverse-fibre exhaustion
thm:supp-finite-exhaustion.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: stratified, stabilizer quotient, inverse fibre, fully reduced, separating functionals, calibration class.

thm:supp-semifinite-exhaustion.title: Completed quasilocal/semifinite inverse-fibre theorem
thm:supp-semifinite-exhaustion.note: No Lean counterpart found; searched: inverse limit, semifinite weight, quasilocal, tightness, stable images, finite intersection property. The inverse-limit files in NCG/Grand concern CTMC/quantum cylinder projective limits, not inverse fibres.
